description: Frontend: author the values JSONB history contract and the Dryer hourly EDIT UX in src/components/DryerSection.jsx. This feature OWNS the JSONB shape (values.__hist, values.__events, values.__ts) that FEAT-002 (trigger) and FEAT-003 (Apps Script) read, so it comes first. Adds edit mode (Edit/Save Changes/Cancel), the read-before-write + merge-by-ts + last_saved_at optimistic guard commit with bounded retry 3 and non-destructive conflict UI, no-op detection, legacy-row seeding, a history-safe saveRow, the single Timestamp-column __events trail, and per-field latest-edit timestamps with muted previous values. Pure helpers are extracted to an importable module so they can be unit-tested without React. Finalized hours (values.__finalized===true) are NOT editable (approval Option A). Independent of FEAT-002/003 at the code level but defines the contract both depend on; must be implemented first.
steps: Create src/components/dryerHistory.js exporting FRAMEWORK-FREE pure functions (no React import): computeRowDiff(baseValues, nextRow) -> set of changed field keys using trim() per scalar and the maintenance boolean-selected-state rule from design 1.4/1.5 (an off/on re-select of an already-selected option is NOT a change and keeps its persisted ISO; clearing a field to empty IS a change); seedLegacyHistory(values, commitIso) -> if values.__events absent/empty, set __events=[{type:'save', ts: rowSeedIso}] where rowSeedIso = min of Object.values(values.__ts) if any, else Date.parse(values.timestamp) toISOString if it parses, else commitIso (design 1.3); and for each field to be edited lacking __hist[field], seed __hist[field]=[{v:<old current>, ts: values.__ts[field] || rowSeedIso}]; applyEdit(values, changedFields, commitIso) -> for every changed field set __ts[field]=commitIso, append {v:<new>, ts:commitIso} to __hist[field], append EXACTLY ONE {type:'edit', ts:commitIso} to __events (not one per field), preserve operator_name and timestamp unchanged (design 1.5a, 2.4 single shared commit); mergeHistoryByTs(persistedValues, localValues) -> union of __hist[field] and __events sorted oldest-first by ts, dedup key (ts, JSON.stringify(v)) for __hist and (ts, type) for __events (design 6 Finding 5); buildEventsTrail(__events) -> 'Original: <fmt> / Edited: <fmt> / ...' using en-IN 12h-with-seconds and timeZone 'Asia/Kolkata' (design 1.3/8), falling back to 'Original: <values.timestamp>' when __events absent; latestFieldEditIso(__hist, field) -> last entry ts when __hist[field] length>=2 else null; fmtIstTs(iso) shared formatter; coerceHistory -> __hist defaults to {} (plain object), __events to [] (array).

Add src/components/dryerHistory.test.mjs importing from ./dryerHistory.js (ESM). Cover: scalar no-op vs change incl. clearing-to-empty; maintenance off/on re-select = no change and keeps persisted ISO, genuine toggle = change; applyEdit uses ONE commitIso across a multi-field edit producing exactly one __events edit entry and both fields sharing that ts (design 1.6(d)); seedLegacyHistory synthesizes __events[0] from min(__ts) and __hist[field][0] from __ts[field]; mergeHistoryByTs union keeps two same-millisecond different-value edits on one field but dedups an exact (ts,v) replay to one; buildEventsTrail formats IST; coerceHistory defaults absent __hist/__events.

In src/components/DryerSection.jsx, import the helpers from ./dryerHistory.js and extend normalizeForm's per-row coercion to preserve/default __hist (object {}) and __events (array []) WITHOUT stripping them (design 8, 9a item 1). Leave emptyRow() persisted scalars unchanged.

Add per-row edit state (e.g. rowEditing[i]). Render an Edit button beside the existing per-row Save (near line ~1649, the 'Save' td) ONLY when row.saved===true && !row.__finalized (design A1, section 5 Option A). In edit mode swap the Save/Edit controls for Save Changes + Cancel for that row. Cancel restores the row from a pre-edit local snapshot and writes nothing (A4). setRow/toggleMaintenance already flip saved:false; that behavior is unchanged.

Implement the Save Changes commit: (1) re-read persisted values + last_saved_at by identity via supabase.from('dryer_hourly_draft').select('values,last_saved_at').match({dryer_type, log_date:form.date, hour, shift:form.shift}); (2) computeRowDiff against the FRESH values; if zero diffs -> TRUE NO-OP: do NOT upsert and restore the row to a clean non-editing end-state identical to Cancel but sourced from the freshly-read persisted snapshot (saved:true, rowEditing[i]=false, reset field values/__ts/__hist/__events) (design 1.4, 8 no-op end-state, A9/AT5); (3) otherwise compute const commitIso=new Date().toISOString() once, run seedLegacyHistory if __events absent, applyEdit, mergeHistoryByTs against the fresh history; (4) upsert with onConflict 'dryer_type,log_date,hour,shift' GUARDED on last_saved_at equal to the freshly-read value (optimistic guard; last_saved_at is the version token, NO schema column added), bumping updated_at/last_saved_at; (5) on a zero-row guard mismatch re-run the read-merge-write loop, BOUNDED to 3 attempts; (6) on exhaustion surface a CLEAR NON-DESTRUCTIVE inline conflict message that keeps the operator's entered values intact and writes NOTHING (design 6 guard-exhaustion). Reuse the existing saveRow try/catch error handling for query/upsert errors (design 10). Keep operator_name and timestamp untouched.

Make the legacy per-hour saveRow history-safe: keep __hist/__events/__ts flowing through the existing `const {timestamp,saved,...fields}=row` destructure; on FIRST save of an hour seed __events:[{type:'save', ts: nowIso}] captured at the same instant as the stamp12hr() string, else preserve existing __events (existingEvents.length ? existingEvents : [seed]) and NEVER append an edit event here; route a re-save of an already-saved/edited hour through the same read-before-write + mergeHistoryByTs path as Save Changes so a stale in-memory row cannot overwrite newer history (design 9a). Keep the operator-facing behavior (same identity, upsert, success toast, error handling) byte-for-byte unchanged.

Replace the single Timestamp badge (around line ~1620, `safeForm.rows[i].timestamp`) with buildEventsTrail(__events) -> 'Original: ... / Edited: ...' (IST), falling back to 'Original: <timestamp>' for pre-feature rows; keep ONE column, add no second column (A6). Under each field whose __hist[field] length>=2 render a small muted latest-edit timestamp (latestFieldEditIso, IST) and expose previous values newest-first as muted/light history (tooltip or expandable) (A7); fields with no __hist or length 1 render nothing extra (A8). Keep styling/layout/field order unchanged (A10); behavior identical for dryer_type 'new'/ND1 and 'old'/ND2 (A11).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` succeeds with the new module and modified component.
`node src/components/dryerHistory.test.mjs` exits 0 with all assertions passing.
Edit control renders only on rows where saved===true and !__finalized; Save Changes/Cancel appear in edit mode (verified by reading the JSX branch logic; no component test runner exists).
A no-op Save Changes performs no upsert and returns the row to a non-editing clean end-state (no stuck edit mode), per design section 8.
The commit computes exactly one commitIso per Save Changes and appends exactly one __events 'edit' entry for a multi-field edit (enforced by dryerHistory.test.mjs covering applyEdit).
verification: Run `npm run build` and confirm it completes without errors.
Run `node src/components/dryerHistory.test.mjs` and confirm exit code 0.
Run `node supabase/google_sheets/apps-script/dryer_form_normalize.test.mjs` to confirm normalizeForm changes did not break the 24-row normalization regression.

jsonb_values_contract.description: Finalized values JSONB shape authored by FEAT-001. FEAT-002 (trigger) and FEAT-003 (Apps Script) MUST read exactly these keys.
jsonb_values_contract.flat_fields: values[field] = current scalar value (unchanged legacy contract). maintenance = { shifter_screen: ISO|'' , atomizer_water: ISO|'' } object. operator_name, timestamp (en-IN display string) preserved as-is. __finalized preserved.
jsonb_values_contract.__ts: values.__ts = { field: ISO } of the CURRENT value per field. On a Save-Changes edit every changed field's __ts[field] is overwritten with the one shared commitIso.
jsonb_values_contract.__hist: values.__hist = { field: [ {v, ts}, ... ] } oldest-first, index 0 = original, last = current. Present ONLY for fields edited at least once. Scalars store v=string (may be ''); maintenance stores v = the whole {shifter_screen, atomizer_water} object. coerceHistory defaults __hist to a plain object {}.
jsonb_values_contract.__events: values.__events = [ {type, ts}, ... ] oldest-first. type is 'save' (first/original) or 'edit' (one per Save-Changes commit, NOT one per field). coerceHistory defaults __events to an array [].
jsonb_values_contract.history_tracked_fields: HISTORY_SCALAR_FIELDS = temp_inlet, temp_outlet, temp_actual, temp_fbd1, temp_fbd2, temp_chamber, atomizer_freq, feed_fc, c_pressure, pressure, pt_temp, batch_no, bags_per_hr, bag_size_wt, kg_per_hr, colour, id_frequency, remarks — PLUS maintenance. operator_name and timestamp are NOT history-tracked.
jsonb_values_contract.single_commit_rule: One commitIso = new Date().toISOString() per Save Changes; applied to every changed field's __ts, every changed field's appended __hist entry ts, and the single appended __events edit entry. Verified by dryerHistory.test.mjs.
jsonb_values_contract.canonical_order: Before persist, __hist[field] and __events are sorted oldest-first by ts and deduped by composite key: (ts, JSON.stringify(v)) for __hist, (ts, type) for __events. This is what mergeHistoryByTs produces; the trigger reads the post-merge persisted array.

helper_module.exports: HISTORY_SCALAR_FIELDS, coerceHistory(values), computeRowDiff(baseValues, nextRow)->Set, seedLegacyHistory(values, commitIso, changedFields?), applyEdit(values, changedFields, commitIso, newValues?), mergeHistoryByTs(persistedValues, localValues), fmtIstTs(iso), buildEventsTrail(events, fallbackTimestamp), latestFieldEditIso(hist, field).
helper_module.framework_free: No React import; pure functions over the values contract. Unit-tested by src/components/dryerHistory.test.mjs (node ESM harness, exits 0).

component_changes.normalizeForm: per-row coercion now preserves/defaults row.__hist (object {}) and row.__events (array []) alongside the existing __ts; emptyRow() persisted scalars unchanged.
component_changes.edit_ux: rowEditing[i] state + rowSnapshotRef for Cancel. Edit (✎) button renders only when row.saved===true && !row.__finalized. In edit mode: Save Changes + Cancel. startEdit snapshots the row; cancelEdit restores the pre-edit snapshot and writes nothing.
component_changes.save_changes: saveRowChanges(i): read-before-write (select values,last_saved_at .match(identity) .maybeSingle()); no-op gate via computeRowDiff vs FRESH values -> restoreFromPersisted (saved:true, exit edit, no DB write); else one commitIso, seedLegacyHistory, applyEdit, mergeHistoryByTs; UPDATE guarded on last_saved_at (optimistic version token, .eq / .is-null) .select('last_saved_at'); zero-row => retry, BOUNDED to 3; on exhaustion a non-destructive inline conflict message, values kept, nothing written. operator_name/timestamp preserved.
component_changes.save_row_history_safe: saveRow seeds __events=[{type:'save', ts:nowIso}] (nowIso captured at same instant as stamp12hr()) only when no existing __events; a re-save is routed through a read-before-write + mergeHistoryByTs path; never appends an edit event; operator-facing behavior (identity, upsert, toast, error handling) unchanged.
component_changes.timestamp_column: single Timestamp cell now renders buildEventsTrail(__events) ('Original: ... / Edited: ...', IST Asia/Kolkata) with fallback to 'Original: <timestamp>' for pre-feature rows. ONE column, no second column added.
component_changes.per_field_history: renderFieldHistory(field, ri) renders under each field whose __hist[field].length>=2: muted latest-edit IST timestamp + collapsible newest-first previous values; injected into renderNC, renderTC, the colour <select>, and the maintenance cell (maintenance history formats the selected option labels). Fields with no __hist or length 1 render nothing extra.

findings.upsert_identity: Unchanged: onConflict 'dryer_type,log_date,hour,shift'; payload uses log_date=form.date. ND1('new')/ND2('old') remain separate. last_saved_at is the version token — NO schema column added.

downstream_notes.FEAT-002_trigger: Fingerprint must fold per-field hist length + latest ts and the __events (length + last ts), both null-safe/omitted when absent so pre-feature rows keep the exact 030 event_id. Payload grows hist[field]=__hist[field] (emit when non-empty value OR __hist[field] present) and ts[field] unconditionally for every emitted field. maintenance history key is 'maintenance'.
downstream_notes.FEAT-003_apps_script: dryerCellWithHistory_(hist) renders scalars newest-first (current v + ts, then 'Previous: v / ts'); dryerMaintCellWithHistory_(hist) renders the maintenance object entries newest-first ('(none)' for a prior all-deselected state). Reads entry ts from hist[].ts, not p.ts[field].

findings.verification: npm run build (exit 0); node src/components/dryerHistory.test.mjs (exit 0, 49 assertions); node supabase/google_sheets/apps-script/dryer_form_normalize.test.mjs (exit 0, 24-row normalization regression intact).
